decisions.reason: The given Countable Choice already licenses both polar-measure suppliers and the Fourier suppliers. Corrected the exclusive axiom-use attribution; the normalization integral, harmonic ODE, boundedness and t-downarrow-zero limit prove the unchanged multiplier identity.

Full AC already implies the Countable Choice required by the divergence and polar-measure interfaces. Corrected the assertion that divergence requires full AC. The punctured-ball flux has the positive delta sign; its other boundary term is O(epsilon) and the omitted volume integral is O(epsilon squared).

The capacity definition has compact-set domain, implicitly invoked by the conventions but not repeated. Made compactness explicit, corrected ds_Y=s ds_y, and qualified the zero scale correction at s=1. Pushforward is a bijection of probability measures and shifts every extended energy by -log s, so taking infima and exponentiating proves homothety without assuming an energy minimizer.

The correction factors through total charge but has rank zero at s=1. Qualified the title and example and checked the nonzero case. Also supplied the missing admissibility check for capacity homothety: compactness, kernel lower bound -log 2, and finite energy of normalized arclength via its integrable logarithmic diagonal singularity.

The descending recurrence is supplied only for ell>=1; the degree-zero definition directly gives h0 prime=(i-1/z)h0. Added that separate branch and restricted the recurrence. The outgoing radiation residual vanishes and the incoming residual has limiting magnitude two at every degree, so finite-dimensional coefficient elimination and the unchanged modewise conclusion remain valid.

Rephrased A1 as the actual assumption rather than attributing contextual assertions to the definition of Countable Choice. The mesh refers to the CC trace-space definition, while the residual itself is deterministic: convex paths preserve separation d, gradient bounds yield (hT+hS)/(4pi d squared), and positive area sums give the entry bound and physical cluster normalization.

The original local double-integral proof introduced hT squared/area(T), hence the family shape-regularity constant, and did not establish its stated family-independent C. Replaced only step 1.1 with fixed-atlas Fourier smoothing at length h, L2 projection contraction and shape-independent convex Poincare. The L2 approximation is now uniform across families; the existing zero-mean duality argument then proves the unchanged h^(3/2) estimate. No statement was weakened.

The stated surface is from the combined-field definition, whose Definition explicitly imports the chart-space convention of def-bem-lipschitz-polyhedral-boundary-and-trace-spaces. That convention begins Assume Countable Choice. Thus the stated context supplies CC for both polar-measure suppliers and the plane-kernel lemma. The bounded Helmholtz remainder and integrable C2 curvature remainders give the claimed smooth-density jumps; no additional full AC assumption is required.

The actual cited supplier proves the supposedly missing facts: extension step 3.1 constructs S=G*Tlambda with common trace; step 4.1 proves the distributional double-layer source, constructs D=S q-(1+k squared)G*f-f, and explicitly concludes trace jump -phi. Steps 1.1 and 5.1 provide smooth-density approximation and weak Green identities. Substitution into the bilinear distributional jump identity cancels the dipole term and gives common D conormal and S conormal jump lambda. These are proved intermediate facts, even though not all are repeated in its Statement.

F1 over-attributed chart approximation to the trace/lift Statement. Removed that extra attribution: step 2.1 already invokes F5, the graph-Sobolev-Green interface, whose first-order Green identity applies directly to H1 inputs. Extension yields the interior L6 realization, the prescribed jump supplies the dipole source, and the global harmonic difference vanishes by its O(R^(5/2))+O(R) L1 growth and the R^(-3) mean-value bound. Statement and dependencies are unchanged.

The trace/lift Statement does not promise chart approximation. Restated F1 accurately and supplied step 2.1 approximation using the bounded Lipschitz extension supplier, now explicitly cited as F6 for both interior and exterior collars, followed by derivative commutation and L2 approximate-identity convergence in F4. Bounded trace convergence passes the first-order identity with no edge flux. Step 4.1 cites the actual approximation for the normal-slice identity, preserving the full Sobolev-density representation and face-interior half-jumps.

The supplier Statement grants Green identities for layers, while the uniqueness proof needs arbitrary weak solutions. Corrected F1 to its actual trace/lift interface and derived the needed identity in step 2.1: zero-trace cutoff approximation licenses weak tests, the compact trace lift defines an independent bounded conormal, and an outer-sphere lift gives the boundary flux. The real energy has zero inner trace term; positive Hankel flux eliminates all modes, then the harmonic lift gives continuation throughout the connected exterior.

F2 explicitly refers to the local trace computation, not solely its exported jump difference. That actual supplier step 3.1 proves gamma-plus D0=one-half phi+K0 phi with common integrable remainder, and step 1.1 adds the bounded Helmholtz remainder without a jump. F2 identifies Kk as the surface integral of the double-layer boundary kernel, which is absolutely integrable by the C2 normal cancellation. The target-derivative Schur estimate gives H^(3/4) smoothing and compactness in H^(1/2); hence the stated decomposition is supported and Kk is defined.

Made the AC and Countable Choice hypotheses of the quasioptimality and Poincare suppliers explicit rather than referring only to mesh/coercivity hypotheses. With Pi_h lambda in X_h, best approximation is bounded by its averaging error; the repaired supplier now establishes a family-independent h^(3/2) bound, and multiplication by the fixed quasioptimality constant gives the stated rate. There are no direct dependency/reference item consumers; the page already carries the same choice context.

Corrected A1 and axiom_use so def-countable-choice supplies only the axiom, while the positive Gaussian rules and remainder bounds are attributed to F6 and integration to F8. Checked the four-dimensional sign-cell/pulling-simplex decomposition, zero-face dimensions 0 through 2, Jacobian D r^(3-j)(1-r)^j, positive opposite-face denominator, derivative recurrence and midpoint error decay. The weak pairing follows from bounded-density potential continuity, bounded traces and dominated convergence; no quadrature or termination conclusion was changed.

SCHEMA explicitly requires a definition/algorithm justified_by result to depend on that procedure through deps, while forbidding only a reverse deps edge. This is precisely the present relation. The transfer theorem F4 treats the algorithm as instructions, explicitly says the guarantee is proved below rather than assumed, and proves standard-branch termination in step 1.5 from panel-pair/FMM remainders and shrinking arithmetic radii. Thus justified_by is a well-definedness discharge, not a circular logical premise. All finite branches, positive tolerances, physical charges, gamma-h certificate and uncertified outputs are specified.
